project.name: Worker X
project.subtitle: Pronto and SnapIt copy for Hyderabad
project.summary: Design, build, deploy, and operate a Hyderabad-focused worker application modelled on Pronto-style shift booking and SnapIt-style nearby-job discovery. The first release is a worker-facing product for gig and shift workers in Hyderabad, with English and Telugu copy, local zones, and UPI-oriented earnings.
project.engagement_type: Fixed-price application build with monthly managed services
project.build_duration: Approximately 4 to 6 weeks from kickoff, subject to timely content, approvals, and store accounts

commercials.gst_note: All amounts are in Indian Rupees and exclusive of applicable GST unless stated otherwise.

one_time_allocation.notes: Worker app build covering registration, jobs/shifts, check-in, earnings, and notifications
Hosting configuration, environments, domains, backups, and first-period server setup
Production release, store listing support, and launch checklist
Pronto/SnapIt feature mapping, Telugu/English copy structure, and Hyderabad zone setup
Test cycles, defect closure for in-scope items, and handover notes

payment_schedule.milestone: On written acceptance of this quotation
payment_schedule.notes: 50% of the one-time fee to commence work

payment_schedule.milestone: Monthly from the month of go-live

modules: Worker registration, profile, skills, and basic KYC document upload
Nearby job and shift discovery modelled on SnapIt-style browse-and-apply
Shift claim / apply flow modelled on Pronto-style on-demand work
Geo-aware check-in and check-out for accepted work
Earnings ledger with UPI-oriented payout status views
Push notifications for new work, reminders, and status changes
English and Telugu content fields for core worker screens
Hyderabad zone/area tagging for discovery (for example HITEC City, Gachibowli, Secunderabad, Old City)
Admin/content hooks so job categories, banners, FAQs, and city copy can be updated after launch
managed_services: Bug management: triage, reproduce, and fix in-scope defects in the live Worker X application
Content updates: job categories, banners, FAQs, city copy, and approved store-listing text
Minor patches and staging-to-production publishes of approved fixes
Monthly health note covering incidents, content changes, and open items
exclusions: Employer/client-facing console beyond the minimum needed to publish jobs and content
New feature development outside the agreed Worker X first-release scope
Play Store / App Store developer account fees, Apple/Google review charges, SMS/OTP vendor fees, and payment-gateway transaction charges
Ongoing cloud usage above the server setup included in the one-time fee
24/7 on-call, field operations, worker onboarding campaigns, or legal/compliance filings
Native maps SDKs, advanced ML matching, or payroll/ESI/PF statutory processing
assumptions: Nhancio will reuse proven product patterns from Pronto and SnapIt rather than inventing a new marketplace category
The client will supply brand assets, Telugu/English copy, job categories, and Hyderabad zone lists on request
Store developer accounts, domains, and payment/UPI credentials will be provided by the client or created in the client's name
One worker application surface is in scope (mobile-first web or a single store build, as agreed at kickoff)
Managed services cover bugs and content updates, not a second product or a full rewrite

terms.validity: This quotation remains valid until the stated validity date unless withdrawn earlier in writing.
